description_en: Sends communication records of a Xuantan service ticket or demand ticket back to Xuantan for viewing. Tickets in the unfollowed status are changed to the following-up status
description_zh: 调用该接口，可将玄坛服务单或需求单的沟通记录回传至玄坛，可在玄坛进行查看，未跟进状态的订单会转为跟进中
kebab_example: aliyun companyreg record-post-back --biz-type esp.zhangsan --biz-id P111111111111 --contactor '张雯菲' --content '联系客户一次' --entity-key esp_produce --api-version 2020-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecordPostBack

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the demand ticket or service ticket
parameters.help_zh: 业务id，需求单或服务单业务id
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the contact person (in Chinese)
parameters.name: contactor

parameters.help_en: The entity type. Specifies whether the operation is performed on a service ticket or a demand ticket
parameters.help_zh: 实体类型，明确操作的是服务单还是需求单
parameters.name: entity_key
